subject: Sufficiently informative stock, use and service-event evidence can distinguish absence of refill need from need accompanied by a documented obstacle.
rationale: Under the stated sufficiency condition, household-specific stock and use evidence can establish whether refill need arose, while documented service events can establish an accompanying obstacle. Alignment can help resolve timing; it cannot independently establish need or causation. This licenses the limited distinction for some participating households without asserting that qualifying evidence has been collected, that an obstacle caused nonpurchase, or that the distinction explains the population decline.
